title: Kissed Tender Moroccan Green Pepper Bissara
description: A comforting and flavorful Moroccan dish featuring tender green peppers, served in a hearty bissara soup.
name: onion
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add diced onion and saute until softened, about 3-4 minutes, with the heat on low-middle setting.
Add the green bell peppers and cook until tender, about 8-10 minutes, maintaining the low-middle heat setting.
Add the chickpeas, salt, and any desired additional spices to the pan and stir to combine.
Mash the chickpea mixture with a fork or the back of a spoon to create a chunky texture, much like traditional bissara.
Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and let it cool slightly, to about 100-1054F.
Once cooled, add this mixture to a blender or food processor with 1/4 cup of water, and blend until smooth.
Return the blended mixture to the bowl and stir in any additional desired spices and herbs.
Heat a medium-sized non-stick pan with a small amount of coconut oil over low heat.
Using a spoon, scoop small amounts of the bissara mixture into the pan, forming small patties.
Cook the patties for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they develop a lightly toasted surface.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
